title: ID Photo

seo.title: ID Photo Maker
seo.description: Online ID photo processing: smart background removal, compliance check, size selection, and print layout.

workflow: Upload & Process -> Adjust Size/Color -> Export (1 Credit for both)

upload.title: Upload Photo
upload.hint: For best results, use a front-facing photo with even lighting and visible shoulders.
upload.failed: Upload failed. Please try again later.

uploadQuality.title: Upload Quality Gate
uploadQuality.subtitle: Complete key quality checks before upload to reduce rework later.
uploadQuality.analysisPending: Face and compliance pre-checks will appear after processing.

hints.format: JPG/PNG is recommended, avoid re-compressed screenshots
hints.face: Keep exactly one clear front face
hints.warnings: Higher pass confidence with zero warnings

warnings.no_face: No face detected, please upload a front-facing, well-lit photo
warnings.side_face: Side face detected, ID photos require facing the camera
warnings.multiple_faces: {{count}} faces detected, ID photos require only one person
warnings.low_resolution: Image resolution {{width}}x{{height}} is low, at least 600x600 pixels recommended
warnings.low_confidence: Low face detection confidence, may affect processing quality
warnings.face_too_small: Face too small in the frame, consider cropping or moving closer
warnings.face_too_large: Face too large in the frame, consider moving further away

tips.front: Face the camera with level eyes
tips.light: Use even lighting and avoid hard shadows
tips.shoulder: Keep shoulders fully visible with headroom

spec.title: Size & Background
spec.hint: Changes take effect instantly. Log in to export watermark-free.

export.title: Export & Print Layout
export.hint: Export requires login. 1 Credit covers both single photo and print layout.
export.loginRequired: Export failed. Please log in and try again.
export.layoutLoginRequired: Layout export failed. Please log in and try again.

preview.title: ID Photo Preview
preview.failed: Preview generation failed. Please try again.

adjust.title: Position & Scale
adjust.hint: Drag inside the preview frame to reposition. Use mouse wheel or sliders to zoom and fine-tune.

compliance.title: Compliance Check Results
compliance.subtitle: Core ID-photo rules are scored automatically. Prioritize unresolved checks first.

advice.title: Optimization tips
advice.ok: Current result looks stable. You can continue to export.
advice.fixIntro: Address these checks first to improve pass confidence:
advice.moreIssues: {{count}} more checks can still be improved.

compliance.noChecks: No checks were returned yet. Please retry shortly.

face_detected.label: Face detected
face_detected.fail: No face detected in the photo

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.fail: Resolution too low, at least 600x600px recommended

contrast.label: Contrast
contrast.fail: Contrast too low, try improving lighting

face_ratio.label: Head ratio
face_ratio.fail: Head too large or too small in the frame

head_tilt.label: Head tilt
head_tilt.fail: Head is tilted, keep eyes level

eyes_open.label: Eyes open
eyes_open.fail: Eyes not clearly detected or appear closed

mouth_closed.label: Mouth closed
mouth_closed.fail: Smile or open mouth detected, keep mouth closed

expression.label: Expression
expression.fail: Maintain neutral expression, look directly at camera

bgColor.title: Background Color
bgColor.previewHint: Color changes apply instantly to the photo preview.
bgColor.tipSolid: Use solid background colors and avoid gradients.
bgColor.tipContrast: Keep clear contrast around hair edges and shoulders.
bgColor.invalidHex: Enter a valid HEX color (for example #4C8BF5).

paywall.title: Log in to Export
paywall.description: Log in to export. 1 Credit covers both single photo and print layout.
